title: Best Lux Lights Alternatives for Roofline Lighting 2026
body_markdown:
Lux Lights sells a name homeowners already trust from yard signs and Nextdoor referrals — that's real, and it's why the brand shows up on so many "best permanent lighting" shortlists in 2026. The ceiling shows up after the sale: dealer-model lighting brands route your install through whichever local crew signed on that quarter, and the person who closed the deal usually isn't the person on your roof. **The best Lux Lights alternative in 2026 is CleanGutters Lighting if you're in South Jersey, Eastern Pennsylvania, or Northern Delaware and want the owner installing your system; Trimlight if you need the largest nationwide dealer footprint instead.**


**TL;DR**

- CleanGutters Lighting wins for South Jersey, Eastern PA, and Northern Delaware homeowners who want owner-installed permanent roofline lighting, not a subcontracted crew.
- Lux Lights alternatives worth comparing in 2026 include Trimlight, Gemstone Lighting, and Astoria Lighting — all dealer-network brands with different coverage and app-control approaches.
- Lux Lights' real strength is brand recognition; its ceiling is installer consistency once the sale is signed.
- Pick a nationwide dealer brand only if you live outside a smaller installer's direct service area.


## Why this matters

Permanent roofline lighting is a 10-20 year fixture on your house, not a seasonal string you replace every winter. The installer who mounts it matters more than the logo on the truck, because the channel has to be sealed to the fascia correctly the first time or you're troubleshooting a flickering zone in year three.

Most homeowners searching for [lux lights alternatives](https://cleangutterslighting.com/) aren't unhappy with the lights themselves — they're unhappy with the gap between the sales pitch and who actually shows up to install. That gap is where dealer-network brands lose homeowners, and it's the single biggest factor to weigh before you sign anything in 2026.

## Lux Lights alternatives at a glance

| Brand | Best for | Standout feature | How it differs from Lux Lights |
|---|---|---|---|
| Lux Lights | Homeowners who want a recognized national name | Broad marketing reach and dealer availability | Sets the baseline for dealer-network permanent lighting |
| CleanGutters Lighting | South Jersey, Eastern PA, and Northern Delaware homes wanting owner-installed work | Owner on every job, paired with gutter services on the same roofline | Same installer sells and installs — no subcontracted crew |
| Trimlight | Homeowners who want the largest dealer network nationally | App-controlled RGBW channel available through many local dealers | Larger national footprint, quality still varies by local dealer |
| Gemstone Lighting | Buyers focused on a dedicated permanent lighting-only brand | Purpose-built lighting channel and app ecosystem | Lighting-only focus versus a bundled roofline service model |
| Astoria Lighting | Homeowners comparing a newer entrant in the category | Growing dealer network with app control | Newer brand, less installed history than older dealer networks |

See the full [permanent roofline lighting brand comparison](https://cleangutterslighting.com/blog/best-permanent-roofline-lighting-brands) for how these stack up feature by feature.

## 1. CleanGutters Lighting: best for owner-installed roofline lighting in South Jersey and Eastern PA

CleanGutters Lighting has operated in South Jersey, Eastern Pennsylvania, and Northern Delaware since 2009, and the person who quotes your job is the same person on the ladder. That matters most on the exact failure point that trips up dealer-network installs: fascia mounting and channel sealing done by someone who has no stake in callback quality.

Because CleanGutters Lighting also runs gutter guard installation and gutter repair, the roofline gets assessed as one system — lighting channel, fascia condition, and gutter attachment together — instead of a lighting-only crew ignoring a soffit issue that will cause problems later.

**Where CleanGutters Lighting shines**
- Alex installs every job personally — no subcontracted crews
- Roofline lighting and gutter protection quoted and installed as one project when both are needed
- Local service area means faster response for warranty and adjustment calls

**Where CleanGutters Lighting falls short**
- Service area is regional — South Jersey, Eastern PA, and Northern Delaware only, not a national footprint
- Smaller installer name recognition than a franchise brand like Lux Lights or Trimlight

**Best for:** homeowners inside the South Jersey, Eastern PA, or Northern Delaware footprint who want one installer accountable for the whole roofline.

| Dimension | CleanGutters Lighting | Lux Lights |
|---|---|---|
| Installer | Owner-installed, every job | Subcontracted local dealer varies by region |
| Service area | South Jersey, Eastern PA, Northern Delaware | National dealer network |
| Bundled services | Lighting, gutter guards, and gutter repair together | Lighting-focused dealer model |
| Local response | Direct line to the installer | Routed through dealer's office |

## 2. Trimlight: best for homeowners who want the widest dealer network

Trimlight is one of the largest names in permanent roofline lighting, with dealers operating across most of the country and an app-controlled RGBW channel that's become the category benchmark other brands get compared against, including Lux Lights.

**Where Trimlight shines**
- Dealer availability in most metro areas nationwide
- App control is mature and widely reviewed across markets

**Where Trimlight falls short**
- Install quality still depends on which local dealer you land with, same as Lux Lights
- Franchise pricing and package structure can vary by territory

**Best for:** homeowners outside a smaller regional installer's footprint who still want app-controlled lighting from a name with national reach. Compare it directly against Lux Lights on the [Trimlight alternatives](https://cleangutterslighting.com/blog/best-trimlight-alternatives) page.

## 3. Gemstone Lighting: best for a lighting-only dedicated brand

Gemstone Lighting positions itself as a purpose-built permanent lighting brand rather than a general exterior contractor that added lighting to the menu. That focus shows in how deep its app ecosystem goes for scene-setting and holiday presets.

**Where Gemstone Lighting shines**
- Lighting-first product development and app support
- Dealer network covers a wide range of regions

**Where Gemstone Lighting falls short**
- No bundled gutter or fascia inspection — you're hiring a separate contractor for roofline issues
- Dealer install consistency is the same variable every franchise model carries

**Best for:** homeowners who only want lighting and are already confident their gutters and fascia are in good shape.

## 4. Astoria Lighting: best for homeowners comparing a newer entrant

Astoria Lighting is a newer name in the permanent lighting category, building out dealer coverage and app control features to compete with the established brands.

**Where Astoria Lighting shines**
- Actively expanding dealer network in 2026
- App control comparable to older, more established brands

**Where Astoria Lighting falls short**
- Shorter track record than Trimlight, Gemstone Lighting, or Lux Lights
- Fewer long-term installs to judge fixture durability against

**Best for:** homeowners who prioritize newer app features over a longer installed track record.

## Why people switch from Lux Lights

- **The installer isn't who you talked to.** Dealer-network sales reps close the deal; a separate crew — sometimes a different one each season — handles the physical install.
- **Warranty support gets routed through a dealer office**, not the person who actually mounted the channel to your fascia.
- **Roofline condition gets ignored.** A lighting-only crew has no reason to flag a sagging fascia or a gutter issue sitting right next to the channel they're installing.



## When staying with Lux Lights is the right call

If you live outside South Jersey, Eastern Pennsylvania, and Northern Delaware, Lux Lights and other national dealer networks like Trimlight are the more practical option — a regional installer simply can't serve you. Staying with a national brand also makes sense if you're prioritizing brand name recognition over having the same person quote and install the job.

## FAQ


**What's the best Lux Lights alternative in 2026?**

CleanGutters Lighting is the best Lux Lights alternative for homeowners in South Jersey, Eastern Pennsylvania, or Northern Delaware who want owner-installed permanent roofline lighting. Outside that footprint, Trimlight offers the widest national dealer network as an alternative.

**Is CleanGutters Lighting better than Lux Lights?**

CleanGutters Lighting is better for homeowners who want the same person quoting and installing the job, since Alex installs every project personally rather than routing it to a subcontracted crew. Lux Lights has a wider national dealer footprint if you live outside CleanGutters Lighting's service area.

**Does CleanGutters Lighting install gutter guards along with roofline lighting?**

Yes, CleanGutters Lighting installs micro-mesh gutter guards, handles gutter repair, and installs permanent roofline lighting, so the whole roofline gets assessed as one system rather than by separate contractors.

**How is Trimlight different from Lux Lights?**

Trimlight and Lux Lights both run dealer networks with app-controlled lighting, so install quality on either depends on which local dealer handles your job. Trimlight generally has a wider dealer footprint across the country.

**What areas does CleanGutters Lighting serve?**

CleanGutters Lighting serves South Jersey, Eastern Pennsylvania, and Northern Delaware. Homeowners outside that region need a different installer or a national dealer brand.

**Is a dealer-network lighting brand worse than a local installer?**

Not automatically worse, but dealer-network brands like Lux Lights route installs through whichever local crew is signed on, so consistency varies by region. A local, owner-installed company removes that variable inside its service area.

**How long has CleanGutters Lighting been in business?**

CleanGutters Lighting has served South Jersey and the surrounding region since 2009, working on both gutter systems and permanent roofline lighting.

**Which permanent lighting brand has the best app control?**

Trimlight and Gemstone Lighting both have mature app ecosystems as of 2026, with scene presets and remote scheduling. Newer brands like Astoria Lighting are building comparable features but have a shorter track record.


## One last thing

The detail that gets skipped in every dealer-brand pitch, Lux Lights included, is fascia condition — a lighting channel mounted to a soft or sagging fascia board will loosen within a season or two regardless of which brand's name is on the fixture. Ask any installer, CleanGutters Lighting or otherwise, to check fascia condition before the channel goes up in 2026, not after.
